label: Every distinct esse has some cause, from De ente's exhaustiveness and self-causation
meaning: The De ente decomposition of the extra premise: the efficiently read nature-or-other exhaustiveness (NATURE_SOURCE_2) and the De ente self-causation reading give every actual distinct esse some cause of being (possibly the thing itself, which no-self-causation then excludes downstream). Composed with the step from caused to caused by another, this reconstructs the De ente c.3 [69874] inference (Baur/Koch; Leonine c.4) as three sourced or open inputs plus the efficiency bridge one level up.
